name: Trench Hymn Leviathan

Traits.name: Amphibious
Traits.text: The hymn leviathan can breathe air and water.

Traits.name: Fear Aura
Traits.text: The hymn leviathan emanates an aura in a 20-foot Emanation while it doesn't have the Incapacitated condition. *Wisdom Saving Throw*: DC 24, any enemy that starts its turn in the aura. *Failure:* The target has the Frightened condition until the start of its next turn. *Success:* The target is immune to this creature's aura for 24 hours.

Traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
Traits.text: If the hymn leviathan fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The hymn leviathan makes two Flukes attacks.

Actions.name: Flukes
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +16, reach 15 ft. 22 (3d8 + 9) Bludgeoning damage plus 14 (4d6) Thunder damage.

Actions.name: Drowning Hymn (Recharge 5-6)
Actions.text: *Constitution Saving Throw*: DC 24, each creature in a 60-foot Cone. *Failure:* 78 (12d12) Thunder damage, and the target has the Deafened condition until the end of its next turn. *Success:* Half damage only.

Legendary Actions.name: Legendary Action Uses: 3
Legendary Actions.text: Immediately after another creature's turn, the hymn leviathan can expend a use to take one of the following actions. It regains all expended uses at the start of each of its turns.

Legendary Actions.name: Circling Lunge
Legendary Actions.text: The hymn leviathan moves up to half its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks, and it makes one Flukes attack.

Legendary Actions.name: Shouldering Surge
Legendary Actions.text: *Strength Saving Throw*: DC 24, each creature within 10 feet of the hymn leviathan. *Failure:* The target has the Prone condition.

Bonus Actions.name: Retributive Shockwave
Bonus Actions.text: One creature within 5 feet that hit the hymn leviathan with an attack roll since the end of the hymn leviathan's last turn takes 14 (4d6) Thunder damage.

lore: A vast leviathan that has lurked in the deepest trench since the first keel broke the surface, singing down through the dark because every hull that sinks into its water is a note it wants to keep.

generation.userConcept: a leviathan of the trench whose song drowns fleets
